question: Can a small typed predicate/provenance capsule preserve useful verification decisions under controlled policy/state revisions of genuine public retail tool workflows, and what is its retention/read tradeoff versus strong semantic and sufficient-statistic controls?
contribution_limit: Interface and empirical feasibility extension of established evidence reuse; no new caching theorem or superiority over semantic entailment is claimed.
development: All provider train task IDs; debug only before confirmation; never use provider test IDs for tuning.
confirmation: All 40 provider test IDs, grouped by original task and action family. First native order-write action per task with entire preceding expected trace replayed. Non-order-write-only tasks, native errors, and every exclusion remain in manifest. Ground-truth trace is used for adapter replay, not an actor performance claim.
fragment: requested item subset or allowed reason/nonempty address
not_full_workflow_verification: Payment settlement, dialogue confirmation, free text, complete policy and agent task success are outside this fragment.
edits_origin: Authored controlled interventions, not claims that tau2 supplies a native drift benchmark or natural drift frequencies.
fairness: Identical source/version/field-path notifications, initial evidence and read price. All provenance is trusted wrapper metadata, not actor assertions. Capsule and Z3 receive identical old-policy atom values. Projection retains additional source sufficient statistics, explicitly reported as a retention upper-bound control.
trust: Trusted canonical typed adapter, source service/change notices, and observed data. Undeclared dependencies, dishonest notices, parser errors and distributed races are not covered. Tool/schema semantics not certified by adapter lead to REVIEW.
certificate: Four predicate truth values with per-atom source dependency, record hash/version and policy/adapter digest; no raw order address, user profile, price, item IDs or dialogue is retained.

baselines.dependency_validity: Strong declared field-dependency and revision-aware selective refresh; recompute new formulas from cached atoms if sufficient, do not invalidate on irrelevant edits.
baselines.cached_projection: Retain policy-relevant raw sufficient statistics, including amount, with identical validity checks.
baselines.semantic_z3: General satisfiability-based entailment over same surviving atom facts; caches formula and reuses solver scope.
baselines.compiled_capsule: Compile formula decision regions once and evaluate same known-atom assignment; expected semantic parity with Z3.
baselines.always_fresh: Fresh native order read for every supported episode.

success_criterion: Feasible adapter and parity with semantic solver, correct fail-closed unsupported cases; useful read/retention tradeoff relative to disclosed controls. Null or negative results will be retained. No superiority over strongest semantic baseline is required or implied.
frozen_budget: 40 confirmation task groups x 9 edits x 5 methods maximum; CPU only; no models, humans, paid API or network execution of workflows.
executor: Saurav K. Aryal (automated experiment execution prepared by Codex)
authentication_context: Every eligible public task is evaluated in the same controlled post-authenticated-session wrapper: trusted caller principal equals original fixture order owner; held fixed across edits. This is a declared test assumption, not observed actor authentication. Expected-trace authentication witness coverage is separately reported.

edit_semantics.policy_equivalent: Conjoin the same four atoms in reverse order.
edit_semantics.policy_weaken_request: Drop request-scope obligation, retaining auth AND owner AND status.
edit_semantics.policy_decision_change: Replace status with NOT status in four-obligation conjunction.
edit_semantics.policy_new_amount_cap_500: Conjoin order item total <=500; this fact was not retained by the original four-atom capsule.
edit_semantics.source_relevant_status: Set real public order status to processed; publish changed path order.status but not its value.
edit_semantics.source_relevant_owner: Set real public order user_id to the first different existing public user; trusted caller stays fixed; publish order.user_id.
edit_semantics.source_irrelevant_address: Set real public order shipping zip to00000; publish order.address.zip.
edit_semantics.unsupported_external_risk: Introduce an unimplemented external risk obligation; all methods REVIEW.
edit_semantics.unknown_tool_semantics: Uncertified tool-semantics revision; all methods REVIEW.

oracle: Direct independent audit of current wrapper state and fixed formal fragment; native write success and postcondition are separate observations. An independent audit program recomputes expected truth from original fixture and intervention without reading method outputs. No claim to full natural-language policy correctness.
missing_auth_handling: Do not infer unauthenticated task from absent expected-trace lookup. Trace presence is metadata only; controlled session context is used uniformly.
amendment: Before confirmation, development identified ordinary short-circuit baseline weakness, projection amount overwrite bug, and50%missing expected-trace auth witness. Retain dev-v1 unchanged. Fix bugs and declare controlled post-auth context for every task; add owner-change stress test. No confirmation results inspected.
